item.author: Students

item.title: Last Day to Make Meal Plan Changes - September 1st
item.description: Please note that students may increase or decrease the size of their residential dining plan up until September 1st. After this, only dining plan increases will be allowed. Note that students are allowed a TOTAL of two plan changes per semester. To make these changes please email dining@rpi.edu and include your full name, RIN and meal plan you currently have and meal plan you want to change to.
item.author: Students

item.title: Fellowship Info Session to Highlight Competitions for Grad School Salary and Tuition: Sept. 16th, 10AM
item.description: Competitive fellowships provide salary and tuition for masters and PhD students. Seniors and graduate students will learn how to find and apply to appropriate programs that will fund fall 2027 and beyond. Programs are available for all stages of your academic career. International students are welcome! Email madige@rpi or Register at https://surveys.rpi.edu/jfe/form/SV_6L3FFwv0qCROrvE
item.author: Students

item.title: Study Abroad & Exchange Welcome Back/Welcome!
item.description: Join Education Abroad as we welcome back the RPI students who studied abroad last semester and summer and welcome our new international exchange students here this fall from partner universities. Enjoy a slice of pizza and learn about study abroad firsthand from fellow students! Undergraduate students considering study abroad are especially encouraged to attend. Tuesday, September 8, 4:00-5:15, Bruggeman Room, CBIS. Contact: Karen Dvorak, Education Abroad Program Manager, dvorak2@rpi.edu.
item.author: Students

item.title: RPI Libraries Open House
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 2, 2026 2:00 PM - 3:30 PM - New students are invited to a fun, relaxed intro to the RPI Libraries to help you succeed at RPI. Grab a bingo card and explore library services, research help, interlibrary loan, study spaces, technology, the Student Success Center, and more. Enter to win raffle prizes from local restaurants and shops. Even better, the first 100 students to complete bingo will enjoy free ice cream and a library goodie bag! Stop in, meet our friendly staff,…
item.author: Students

item.title: First-Gen & BIPOC Student Ice Cream Social
item.description: Come join the Office of Inclusive Excellence on Tuesday, September 8, 2026 from 4–6 PM in the Student Success Center on the 1st Floor of Folsom Library to grab some ice cream, meet fellow students, and learn about the many services, resources, and study spaces available to support you at RPI!
item.author: Students

item.title: ISSS Town Hall: Duration of Status (D/S) Changes
item.description: ISSS is holding a Town Hall to share information about the recent regulatory change to Duration of Status (D/S) that affects individuals in F-1 and J-1 status and their dependents. This event is open to the campus community, and this session focus is on answering graduate student questions. Join us in-person on Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. in the Academy Hall Auditorium, Room 3500. The RPI ID card is required to access the building.
item.author: Students

item.title: Paris Syndrome
item.description: Friday / September 4, 2026 at 9:00 pm Miho Hatori’s Paris Syndrome premieres at TOPOS Music Festival. Surrounded by shifting fields of live sound, voice, and image, encounter what happens when perception begins to slip. Performance, Commission Miho Hatori, with Michiko Ogawa and Daniel Peck
item.author: Community

item.description: Saturday / September 5, 2026 at 12:00 pm Join TOPOS for a free Community BBQ, catered by Brooks’ BBQ and open to the public, with Sound House Records selling and spinning music—a chance for festival artists and audiences to meet, eat, and keep the conversation going. Gathering
item.author: Community

item.title: The Strangeness of Jazz | Edward George
item.description: Date: Thursday, September 3, 2026 6:00 PM - TOPOS Music Festival 2026 welcomes filmmaker, writer, broadcaster, and musician Edward George to EMPAC for a live version of his acclaimed podcast The Strangeness of Jazz. Join us and listen in as George turns his attention to the generative possibilities of the slip—the mistake, stutter, or rhythmic deviation that opens new musical futures. At the center of the program is the work of Jamaican drummer Sly Dunbar. Included with festival pass.
item.author: Community

item.title: そして花びらは燃え、散りゆくAnd The Petals Burst Into Flames… | IMA
item.description: Date: Thursday, September 3, 2026 9:00 PM - Performing at TOPOS in the ambisonic environment of EMPAC’s Studio 1, IMA conjures a sound world suspended between destruction and renewal—searching for fleeting moments of beauty at the edge of collapse. Included with festival pass.
item.author: Community

item.title: Defiant Life | Vijay Iyer and Wadada Leo Smith
item.description: Date: Friday, September 4, 2026 7:00 PM - TOPOS Music Festival welcomes Vijay Iyer and Wadada Leo Smith, performing Defiant Life. Experience the spiritually and sonically intense improvised music of these two pioneering legends in the EMPAC Concert Hall. Included with festival pass & single tickets also available.

item.title: 4 Steps to Effective Communication: Extended DISC
item.description: Description: Our success, both personally and professionally, is largely determined by our ability to communicate effectively with a variety of people. In this workshop, participants will receive individualized Extended DISC reports (based on the completion of the Extended DISC questionnaire) that reflect both their “natural” and adjusted.” See: https://share.percipio.com/cd/ALIOeNXsO Contact: Melissa Duquette: 518-276-3931

item.title: Faculty Meet & Greet
item.description:
The Student Success Center invites faculty to a Meet & Greet on Wednesday, Sept. 2nd from 9am -11am at the Success Center, First Floor of the Folsom Library. Stop by for coffee and light refreshments, connect with our team, and enjoy brief tour of our space. We’ll introduce you to the resources and services available to support you and your students through the upcoming fall semester.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
